description_for_human: Federated developer documentation from 47 vendors — Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel, Kubernetes, and more. Search, error matching, and vendor lookup with version-cited, license-attributed results.
description_for_model: Search and retrieve developer documentation from 47 vendors including Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel, Kubernetes, Bun, Stripe, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, Argo CD, Helm, Flux, Cilium, React, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, Playwright, ClickHouse, Ollama, Electron, Hugo, Docusaurus, pytest, Node.js, Godot, Neovim, Terragrunt, Moby, Svelte, Vue, and Gitea. Tools: search_docs_across (federated search), explain_error (error-to-docs matching), list_vendors (vendor registry with licenses). Every result carries vendor, version, license, and canonical source URL.
